ProcessManager_Config_TriggerKeywordDesc: Type this keyword (optionally followed by a space and a search term) to trigger process search, e.g. the default "ps".
ProcessManager_PluginDesc: Process manager plugin. Supports searching, viewing, and killing currently running system processes.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ProcessManagerInstantPr: Searches running system processes by name, PID, or window title, and provides a one-click action to kill selected processes in the search box.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ProcessManagerTranslati: Provides UI translation and localization mapping for the Process Manager plugin.
